narrative.intro: American Centrifuge Operating has $916M in federal contract obligations for FY2026 to date. American Centrifuge Operating has received 2 awards this fiscal year, with an average award size of $458M. Obligations are up 361.8% year over year. Obligations by fiscal year trace a steady increase from $38.9M in FY21 to $916M in FY26, with intermediate totals of $42.9M in FY22, $50M in FY23, $85M in FY24, and $198M in FY25. Other Basic Inorganic Chemical Manufacturing accounts for the bulk of FY2026 to date obligations at $900M. Nuclear Electric Power Generation accounts for $15.9M in FY2026 to date obligations. The note on accounting clarifies that all figures are contract obligations except award-value figures in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables, which are total contract values, and that current-year totals are partial. This snapshot shows concentrated industry exposure and a large jump in obligations for the current fiscal year relative to prior years.
